entities.name: Nacatl
entities.description: The leonin of Naya, the same race as Mirrodin's leonin but with coats like tigers, jaguars and ocelots.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A leonin planeswalker who has not been a planeswalker long and cannot pinpoint where he lands in Jund or Naya.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An ancient and masterful planeswalker who can likely be wherever he wants whenever he wants.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A red planeswalker used as an example of a mage who always has a burn spell ready.

entities.name: Naya
entities.description: A shard of Alara home to the Nacatl.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: A plane whose leonin keep a stricter lion look.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: A shard where some say blessed mortals can become angels.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: The treacherous meta-void planeswalkers travel through.

relations.quote: The Nacatl of Naya are indeed leonin, the very same race that can be found on Mirrodin.

relations.note: aims at the bright blob in the Blind Eternities and leaps
relations.quote: he just aims at the bright blob in the Blind Eternities, says a little prayer to the spirits, and leaps.
